quotes: In the case of an individual, the exemptions provided by this section shall be allowed as deductions in computing taxable income.
151a.reason: Every possible section 151 exemption claimant is forwarded as a possible section 151 deduction claimant.

quotes: An exemption of the exemption amount for the taxpayer;
an additional exemption of the exemption amount for the spouse of the taxpayer
151b.reason: For the fixed focus, the direct taxpayer possibility contributes focus itself, while the spouse provision contributes possible spouse claimants. Ignoring its income, filing, and dependency conditions only enlarges this upper bound.

quotes: An exemption of the exemption amount for each individual who is a dependent (as defined in section 152) of the taxpayer for the taxable year.
151c.reason: Possible taxpayers whose dependent the focus could be are forwarded as possible exemption claimants.

quotes: the term "exemption amount" means $2,000.
the term "exemption amount" means zero.
151d.reason: This block determines or reduces exemption amounts and does not establish a new positive claimant. Its reference to a deduction allowable to another taxpayer is only an amount condition.

quotes: the term "dependent" means-
a qualifying child, or
a qualifying relative.
152a.reason: A possible qualifying-child claimant or qualifying-relative claimant is forwarded as a possible dependent claimant.

quotes: such individual shall be treated as having no dependents
An individual shall not be treated as a dependent of a taxpayer under subsection (a) if such individual has made a joint return with the individual's spouse
152b.reason: Both provisions are disqualifying exceptions; neither introduces a positive dependent claimant.

quotes: who bears a relationship to the taxpayer described in paragraph (2),
who has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer for more than one-half of such taxable year,
152c.reason: A possible qualifying-child claimant must lie in the conservative relationship upper bound and the co-residence upper bound. The explicit relationship interface is retained alongside family, while age and joint-return disqualifications are ignored to enlarge the candidate set.

quotes: who bears a relationship to the taxpayer described in paragraph (2),

An individual (other than an individual who at any time during the taxable year was the spouse, determined without regard to section 7703, of the taxpayer) who, for the taxable year of the taxpayer, has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer and is a member of the taxpayer's household.
152d.reason: Enumerated relatives are conservatively covered by family and explicit relationship_d2 assertions, while the household alternative contributes household peers. Income, qualifying-child, and spouse exclusions are ignored because doing so enlarges the may-support range.
